name: microfreak-sequence
description: Put a sequence the user describes in words into a MicroFreak preset slot: notes, chords, rests, ties, accents, modulation tracks, patterns A and B, 1 to 64 steps. Use when asked to put, write, program, change or check a sequence, pattern, arpeggio, bass line or riff in a MicroFreak preset or slot. Routes to the garden page Microfreak/Sequence/Write a sequence and the mise tasks microfreak:write-sequence and microfreak:verify-sequence.
